name: Investment Account 83
definition: Account between an investor(s) and a fund manager or a fund. The account can contain holdings in any investment fund or investment fund class managed (or distributed) by the fund manager, within the same fund family.

OwnerIdentification.name: Owner Identification
OwnerIdentification.definition: Party that legally owns the account.

AccountIdentification.name: Account Identification
AccountIdentification.definition: Unique and unambiguous identification for the account between the account owner and the account servicer.

AccountName.name: Account Name
AccountName.definition: Name of the account. It provides an additional means of identification, and is designated by the account servicer in agreement with the account owner.

AccountDesignation.name: Account Designation
AccountDesignation.definition: Supplementary registration information applying to a specific block of units for dealing and reporting purposes. The supplementary registration information may be used when all the units are registered, for example, to a funds supermarket, but holdings for each investor have to be reconciled individually.

AccountServicer.name: Account Servicer
AccountServicer.definition: Institution that maintains the records where the account is held.

SubAccountDetails.name: Sub Account Details
SubAccountDetails.definition: Sub-account of the master or omnibus account.

BlockChainAddressOrWallet.name: Block Chain Address Or Wallet
BlockChainAddressOrWallet.definition: Digital account where digital assets or digital tokens can be stored and where an entry is made.

IntermediaryInformation.name: Intermediary Information
IntermediaryInformation.definition: Party that provides services relating to financial products to investors, for example, advice on products and placement of orders for the investment fund.

SecuritiesForm.name: Securities Form
SecuritiesForm.definition: Form, that is, ownership, of the security, that is, registered or bearer.

DematerialisedIndicator.name: Dematerialised Indicator
DematerialisedIndicator.definition: Indicates whether a security exists only as an electronic record, that is, there is no physical document representing the security.

IncomePreference.name: Income Preference
IncomePreference.definition: Dividend option chosen by the account owner based on the options offered in the prospectus.

BeneficiaryCertificationCompletion.name: Beneficiary Certification Completion
BeneficiaryCertificationCompletion.definition: Beneficial owner or its designated agent certifies that it complies with any holding or investment restrictions or requirements of the fund.

SafekeepingPlace.name: Safekeeping Place
SafekeepingPlace.definition: Place requested as the place of safekeeping.

SettlementPartiesDetails.name: Settlement Parties Details
SettlementPartiesDetails.definition: Chain of parties involved in the settlement of the transaction.
